register_address_scheme: 800G PHYs are managed exclusively via the Clause-45 MDIO MMD address space (5-bit PRTAD + 5-bit DEVAD + 16-bit register), giving a 32 x 32 x 65536 register space per MDIO bus segment. There is NO Clause-22 16-bit register file (BMCR/BMSR) at 800G — the gigabit/10G-era basic register set does not scale to a multi-lane FEC PHY.

clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.name: PMA/PMD
clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.purpose: Physical Medium Attachment + Physical Medium Dependent: per-lane control/status, PMD transmit disable, fault, link-training, electrical/optical compliance status for 800GBASE-DR8/SR8/VR8/2xFR4.

clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.name: PCS
clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.purpose: Physical Coding Sublayer: 64b/66b + 256b/257b status, RS-FEC(544,514) control + corrected/uncorrected codeword + symbol-error counters, PCS-lane alignment-marker lock + lane-mapping, BER monitor.

clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.name: Auto-Negotiation
clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.purpose: Clause-73-class Auto-Negotiation MMD: base/next page exchange, resolved technology, link-training control/status.

clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.name: PMA per-lane
clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.purpose: Per-physical-lane PMA control/status (lane 0..7) for the 8x100G PMD.

clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.name: Vendor-specific
clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.purpose: Vendor-defined MMDs (SerDes equaliser taps, eye monitors, temperature, diagnostics).

fcs_polynomial.name: IEEE 802.3 CRC-32
fcs_polynomial.covers: DA + SA + Type/Length + Payload + Pad (NOT Preamble + SFD).
fcs_polynomial.bit_order: LSB-first within each byte; FCS appended MSB-byte first.
fcs_polynomial.note: UNCHANGED at 800G; the FCS is a MAC-layer integrity check, orthogonal to the PCS RS-FEC(544,514).

notes: 800GbE management is Clause-45-only. The dominant MMDs are PMA/PMD (DEVAD 1), PCS (DEVAD 3, hosting the RS-FEC(544,514) control + corrected/uncorrected codeword + symbol-error counters + PCS-lane alignment status), and Auto-Negotiation (DEVAD 7). PHY identity (PHY ID, vendor OUI) lives in the standard Clause-45 PMA/PMD identifier registers; there is no Clause-22 BMCR/BMSR pair.

pcs_status_registers_summary.name: PCS Status (RS-FEC)
pcs_status_registers_summary.purpose: FEC bypass-correction/indication enable, FEC-aligned, hi-SER (high symbol-error-rate) flag.

pcs_status_registers_summary.name: RS-FEC corrected codewords counter
pcs_status_registers_summary.purpose: Count of RS-FEC(544,514) codewords with <=15 symbol errors that were corrected.

pcs_status_registers_summary.name: RS-FEC uncorrected codewords counter
pcs_status_registers_summary.purpose: Count of codewords with >15 symbol errors (uncorrectable).

pcs_status_registers_summary.name: RS-FEC symbol-error counters (per lane)
pcs_status_registers_summary.purpose: Per-FEC-lane corrected-symbol counts used to monitor the pre-FEC margin against the 1e-13 post-FEC target.

pcs_status_registers_summary.name: PCS-lane alignment-marker lock + mapping
pcs_status_registers_summary.purpose: Per-PCS-lane lock status + the physical-lane-to-PCS-lane mapping after receiver deskew/reorder.

pcs_status_registers_summary.name: BER monitor
pcs_status_registers_summary.purpose: Estimated post-FEC bit error ratio; compared against the 1e-13 objective.
